name: Hotel Garni Glocker
beschreibung: Hotel Garni Glocker is situated in a quiet location in Tirol. The house offers a family atmosphere. The surroundings are characterized by the typical mountain landscape with forests and alpine pastures. In summer, the hiking trails are accessible directly from the hotel, while in winter several ski areas can be reached within a short drive. The amenities include a breakfast room, a sauna, as well as parking and storage facilities for sports equipment. Some of the rooms have a balcony and offer views of the mountains. Guests can expect a quiet base for an active holiday in the Tiroler Alpen.
